reason: Native QQ may deliver an explicit quoted request before the referenced pure attachment. Resolve the reverse reference edge from durable inputs instead of opening a second task.
limits: Same conversation and same author; exact reply_to message ID required.
Only pure file/image/record/video without text/control/reply is eligible.
Unique currently permitted active/paused context only; multiple candidates stay unbound.
No merge of existing contexts, no time heuristic, no cross-author access grant.
Paused context stores input without resuming. Closed/denied contexts do not gain new material.
